# 1on1 Nadia - 2026-09-15

**Time:** 60 min, Tuesday 2 PM
**Person:** [[Nadia Okafor]]

## What Nadia brought up

**Comp.** First thing, before I'd sat down. She's been a TL and a manager since Aug 18 and paid as a TL. She asked whether the manager trial comes with a comp review, and when. Calm, prepared, clearly rehearsed. She'd done the market research I noticed in May.

I told her the truth: yes, there will be a comp review, and it happens after the Series B closes, because that's when bands get reset for everyone. I didn't give a number. She asked if "after close" has a date. Target close is mid-November; the review follows in the first cycle after.

She accepted it. She also said, evenly, that this is the second time she's heard "post-Series B" from me. She's right. It was in my May notes ([[1on1 Nadia - 2026-05-19]]). If I miss this, I lose more than money with her.

**Theo, four weeks in.** Going well. Shipped his first investing-tab fix last week. She's doing weekly 1:1s with him, and she asked how I structure mine. Gave her my template. She'll ignore half of it, correctly.

**Managing feels different than she expected.** Less about technical guidance, more about noticing. She said the hardest part is not jumping in to fix his PRs herself. Told her that never gets fully easier.

**Senior iOS search.** Strongest candidate so far is Ama. Final round next week. Nadia thinks the offer will be tight on comp.

## What I brought up

**Beta week one, iOS side.** Crash-free sessions fine. One support ticket about a share count that didn't match the confirmation screen. Devon found the pattern today: 0.4% of positions off by fractional shares after a corporate action in one ETF. Not her bug. But it's her screen users are staring at, so she should know before support tells her.

**The trial.** Is she enjoying managing? Yes. "More than I thought." That's the answer I was hoping for.

## Commitments

- [x] Nadia: run Ama's final round
- [ ] Me: comp review for Nadia in the first cycle after close, by 2026-11-30
- Me: formalize the manager track at the same review if she still wants it

## Read on Nadia

Steady, and more direct than in May. Asking for comp to my face is a trust signal, not a threat. The risk isn't that she's unhappy; it's that she's patient and I keep spending that patience.

Related: [[Investing Launch]], [[Devon Park]], [[VP Eng Search]] (the VP Eng will inherit her as a manager).
